cohort: The study included 91 pregnant women with clinically and sonographically diagnosed fetal growth restriction in the third trimester.
finding: The study found that abnormal UA S/D ratio was significantly associated with several adverse perinatal outcomes, while MCA PI showed higher specificity and positive predictive value for fetal outcome in FGR compared to UA PI.
mod_finding: Abnormal UA S/D ratio was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery when compared with normal Doppler indices.
